description: This file defines the LoopSubContentTransform class, a custom FreeMarker transformation used within the OFBiz framework to iterate over content-related entities, prepare context data, and render nested content or URLs within FreeMarker templates.

classes.name: LoopSubContentTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker TemplateTransformModel implementation that processes content associations, prepares context data, and renders nested content within Freemarker templates.

methods.name: prepCtx
methods.description: Prepares the template context for iteration by fetching and setting the relevant content data resource views and related information based on the current entity index.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Creates a writer for processing the FreeMarker template, managing iteration over content entities, and rendering nested content or URLs based on the context.

methods.description: Deprecated method for retrieving wrapped objects from the FreeMarker environment.
